jobs.description: Stock Control Officer | DHL Supply Chain | Weert Are you accurate, analytical, and interested in logistics and inventory management? Join DHL Supply Chain in Weert as a Stock Control Officer and help keep our warehouse operations running smoothly. In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring stock levels, identifying discrepancies, and ensuring that inventory information remains accurate and up to date. You will work closely with the warehouse team to investigate stock differences, improve inventory accuracy, and support efficient logistics processes. Whether you already have experience in stock control or are looking to develop your career in logistics, this role offers excellent opportunities to learn and grow. Wie zoeken we? Strong attention to detail and a structured, analytical approach. Good spoken and written English. An interest in logistics, stock control, or supply chain operations. Good knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. Previous experience in stock control or a similar position is an advantage but not required. A reliable, proactive, and independent working attitude. Wat bieden wij je? A gross hourly wage of €15.32. Travel allowance of up to €9.30 per working day. Annual salary increases in line with the applicable Collective Labour Agreement (CLA). Fully paid training and certifications, including EPT, OPT, forklift, and reach truck. Excellent opportunities for career development and internal growth. A stable full-time position with one of the world's leading logistics companies. Functieomschrijving Monitor stock levels and investigate inventory discrepancies. Carry out regular stock counts and cycle counts. Analyse differences between physical stock and system records and identify their causes. Keep inventory information accurate in the warehouse management system. Assist warehouse colleagues with stock-related questions and issues. Identify ways to improve inventory accuracy and streamline stock control processes. Ensureinventory procedures are followed correctly and consistently.

Do you enjoy working with your hands and are you interested in high-tech technology? Then this could be your next step. As an Assembler at ASML, you will work on lithography machines that are used to produce microchips for the world's most advanced technologies. You will work in ASML's cleanroom factory, a unique and highly technological working environment where precision, quality, and teamwork are essential. You do not need to know everything from day one. At ASML, you learn by doing and develop your skills step by step through training, guidance, and hands-on experience. You will work closely with experienced colleagues and become part of a team that builds complex systems with the highest level of accuracy. Wie zoeken we? We are looking for someone who enjoys practical technical work and takes pride in delivering high-quality results. You are comfortable working with your hands, have an eye for detail, and understand the importance of working accurately when assembling complex systems. You enjoy working as part of a team and are willing to help colleagues when needed. At the same time, you take responsibility for your own work and are not afraid to ask questions or take initiative when you encounter a problem. You remain calm when priorities change and approach technical challenges in a practical and structured way. You are eager to learn and open to feedback. Whether you are already experienced in mechanical assembly or are looking to take the next step in your technical career, your motivation and willingness to develop are important. Education and technical experience A vocational qualification (MBO level 3 or 4) or a bachelor's degree in a technical field, such as Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automotive, Aerospace, or a comparable discipline. Hands-on experience in a technical production or service environment. Experience with mechanical assembly, testing, adjustment, and troubleshooting. Experience working with both larger mechanical components afine mechanical parts. Ability to read and understand technical drawings and work instructions. Good command of English, both written and spoken, for daily communication and documentation. Wat bieden wij je? As an Assembler at ASML, you will work in a unique high-tech environment where you can develop your technical skills and contribute to technology that is used all over the world. You will receive extensive training and guidance and have the opportunity to build a long-term career within an international organization. You can expect: A gross monthly salary of €3,771, excluding shift allowance. 25.1% shift allowance. An additional 0.65% ADV allowance. A 13th-month salary. An end-of-year bonus, based on company results. €0.21 per kilometre travel allowance, starting from 10 km one way. Extensive training and development opportunities. The opportunity to work in a highly advanced and innovative high-tech environment. Be Part of the Impact ASML develops and manufactures the world's most advanced lithography systems. These machines play a crucial role in the production of microchips, which are used in virtually all modern technologies. As an Assembler, you are an essential part of this process. Your craftsmanship, precision, and attention to detail ensure that complex components and systems are assembled correctly and meet ASML's high quality standards. Every component you assemble contributes to a larger system, and every system contributes to the technology that enables the next generation of microchips. Your hands. Your craftsmanship. Your impact on the technology of tomorrow. Functieomschrijving After completing a solid training program at the ASML Academy, you will be ready to start working independently within the production environment.
